sections.title: Optical Materials
sections.description: This course discusses the optical properties of modern materials engineered for specific functionality and covers exciting new developments being made in this rapidly evolving field. Emphasis is placed on how modern nanotechnology reshapes the light-matter interaction and delivers novel optical properties that are not available in nature.
